buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && bash scripts/fetch-tailwind.sh && ./bin/tailwindcss -i static/src/app.css -o static/css/app.css --minify && test -f static/css/app.css && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput && python -c "import json,sys; m=json.load(open('staticfiles/staticfiles.json')); sys.exit(0 if 'css/app.css' in m.get('paths', {}) else 1)"
